title: Airport
subtitle: Passenger flow from check in to runway

anchorAudit.rationale: All 390 terminal terms were checked against the 1600 × 900 photograph. Separate anchors now identify the check-in screens, kiosks, screening arches, boarding bridge, aircraft, control tower, suitcases and the reclaim island. Hidden machinery, documents, unreadable signs and unidentifiable equipment remain available in the scene index. The same photograph and its three entrances are retained. Human review of the revised points is pending.

visualRegions.description: Complete bright airport terminal connecting passenger processing to aircraft, apron and runway
The departure hall sign, bank of check-in desks, queue barriers and full-height foreground kiosks.
Walk-through metal detectors and the X-ray scanner with its exposed roller bed and indicator lights.
Terminal direction sign and ceiling above the gate seating and the glass boarding bridge.
The right-hand arrivals carousel, visible suitcases and silver centre island with greenery.
Parked airliner and ground vehicles in front of the distant tower, runway and yellow taxiway markings.
Complete visible left-hand check-in counter bank in the airport photograph

detailZones.title: Check in hall
detailZones.description: Check-in counters, wall monitors, queuing posts and the four self-service kiosks in the left foreground.

detailZones.title: Security screening
detailZones.description: Walk-through arches, the X-ray tunnel and its roller table behind the queue barriers.

detailZones.title: Departure concourse
detailZones.description: The suspended direction sign, window wall, banks of waiting seats and glazed passenger boarding bridge.

detailZones.title: Baggage claim
detailZones.description: Hard-shell suitcases travel around the planted island on a slatted belt with a brushed metal outer panel.

detailZones.title: Airside
detailZones.description: The airliner, ground vehicles, taxiway markings and distant control tower seen through the terminal windows.
